title: fix(objectql)!: a write refused after its before* hook wrote through ctx.api rolls that hook's write back
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVc5Kf7EmenMVtWkcK14F2j)_

Fixes #34412
Ruling-ref: 6929103019

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #34504

MongoDB standalone: NOT MEASURED in this PR (see Acceptance notes); no driver card filed, because the seat's order files one only on a measured refusal, and the ruling was given with this consequence named as read in code, not measured.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：带有元数据声明的保存前钩子（`beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` / `beforeDelete`）的保存，现在整笔放进一个事务；这次保存被拒时，钩子通过 `ctx.api` 顺手写的记录一起撤回。
- 为什么改：保存被拒（例如校验不过）后，钩子先写的旁记录还留在库里，客户看到"保存失败"却多出一条记录（HotCRM 工时单被拒后留下空的周报）。按裁决 A「整笔保存一起撤回」处理。
- 风险与回滚：破坏性变更。钩子往另一个数据源写业务记录会被拒；单机（非副本集）MongoDB 上这些对象的保存会失败（按代码阅读，本机未能实测）；SQLite 上写锁会持有到钩子链跑完。回滚即撤回本 PR，没有数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`（`opensAfterAbortUnit` 中新增的 `sideWriting` 一项）、`.changeset/34412-before-hook-side-write-unit.md`、`packages/objectql/src/engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts`（末尾 #34412 一组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts`，预期 21 个全过；其中"note is absent"三条在去掉修复后会变红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（需契约档 L2 审核记录）。

## What changes

`ObjectQL`'s write door decides per write whether it opens its own unit of work (`opensAfterAbortUnit`). Until now it did so only when a metadata-bound `after*` hook on the object could abort (#22782, #22856). This PR adds one term: a metadata-bound `before*` hook on the same verb also opens the unit. The three exits stay as they are: a caller's open unit decides, an object off the default datasource opens none, and a default driver with no transactions opens none. Code-registered hooks (`registerHook`, no `meta`) still open no unit; the platform's own `sys_stamp_audit_insert` / `sys_stamp_audit_update` are code-registered, and no platform package declares metadata hooks, so the platform's own objects do not change.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-hooks-and-functions.ts` — the predicate and its docblock.
- `engine-insert.ts`, `engine-update.ts`, `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` — call-site comments only.
- `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` — the `before*` row in the unit-of-work table, beside the `after*` one, and what it means for a `before*` hook's `ctx.api` writes (no per-hook opt-out, the cross-datasource refusal and its ledger carve-out, MongoDB replica set).
- `content/docs/api/data-flow.mdx` — the `before*` row of the hook table.
- `.changeset/34412-before-hook-side-write-unit.md` — `minor` on `@objectstack/objectql`, BREAKING, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, the precedent shape of the #22856 changeset.

## Why

A `before*` hook that creates a record through `ctx.api` (the card: a time entry's `beforeInsert` creates the week's timesheet) committed that record at once, because a single write ran in no unit. A refusal later in the same write (a declared validation, a later `before*` hook, a driver constraint) refused the caller and left the hook's record stored. The maintainer ruled route A (6929103019): the whole write rolls back together.

What narrows, named in the changeset:
- a `before*` write meant to survive a refusal now rolls back; no per-hook opt-out. The carve-out is the one any unit has: an append-only ledger on another datasource (`lifecycle.class` `audit` / `telemetry` / `event`) is written outside the unit (`enforceTransactionOrigin`);
- a `before*` hook's `ctx.api` business write to another datasource is refused with `CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError`; remedy: one datasource;
- a MongoDB default store needs a replica set for this unit (see Acceptance notes); remedy: run MongoDB as a replica set.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts` — 8 pins: the card's three verbs (insert / update / delete: the hook's note is absent after the refusal), the flipped throwing-`before*` control (one unit, rolled back), and the controls (success commits both rows; a caller's unit decides; a driver with no transactions keeps the side write and warns nothing; a code-registered hook opens no unit).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-hook-condition-unevaluable-refusal.test.ts` — the REST data door over a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3): `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, the outer row and the hook's row both absent; CONTROL an accepted create keeps both rows.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-ctx-title-one-hop.integration.test.ts` — one stale pin flipped (fix round 1, d4062a6ba1). Its H2 case pinned that a `beforeUpdate` body's `ctx.api.transaction` opened the only unit, so every read on it was the title's hop. Measured on 320f1f8646: one `beginTransaction` (the door's unit; the body's transaction joined it, no second unit), and all five reads of the write on that handle — the prior-row read of `lib_loan`, the title's two hops, and the result row's formula reads of `lib_book` / `lib_reader`. The pin now asserts one unit for the whole write, every read on it, and exactly the title's two hop reads (one `lib_book`, one `lib_reader`) added over the same body that opens the same transaction and never asks. File: `Tests 11 passed (11)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` at d4062a6ba1: `Test Files 609 passed (609)`, `Tests 11271 passed | 19 skipped (11290)`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-hook-stale-summary-refusal.test.ts` — one stale pin updated (fixture triage: replaced). Its `beforeInsert` case pinned the old path ("no unit opens for a before* hook, so the hook's own write stays"); it now pins the unit the hook opens (one begun, one rolled back, the hook's row absent).

Ablation (one mutation, both suites): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `if (!aborting && !sideWriting) return false;` with `if (!aborting) return false;` (anchor x1 to x0, blob `6671f8495a2f` to `2f36f7d8de8e`, trap restore armed), rebuilt `@objectstack/objectql`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the mutation in `dist/{core,index}.{js,mjs}` (the REST suite resolves `@objectstack/objectql` through its `exports`, i.e. `dist/`).
- engine pins: `Tests 5 failed | 16 passed (21)` — red: the three card pins, the throwing-`before*` control, the success control's `begun` count; green as expected: caller-unit, no-transactions and code-registered controls.
- REST pin: `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)` — `expected 1 to be +0` on the hook's row; status/code and outer-row assertions held.
- Restore: blob after restore `6671f8495a2f` == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty; `objectql` rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean over 14 built files, REST pin `7 passed (7)`.

## Acceptance notes

- **MongoDB standalone — NOT MEASURED.** Reason: no `mongod` is available in the build container (the driver's suites are opt-in through `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED` and download the server from `fastdl.mongodb.org`, which the container's egress policy refuses with 403). Code reading only: `MongoDBDriver.beginTransaction` always calls `session.startTransaction()` and the driver declares no `supports.transactionsUnsupported`, so on a standalone server the first write in the unit should be refused by the server (transactions need a replica set member or mongos). The driver is out of this PR's surface; no card is filed on a code reading alone (see the line at the top); the measurement is carried on #34563.
- **PR #34439 (#33795, roll-up deferral in batch writes).** `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against its head `54bc155b88` is clean (no conflicted path). Behavioural interaction: inside its deferral scope a write that now opens this unit records its roll-up recompute instead of running it; the door's unit is ambient (`txStore`, `inAfterAbortUnit` → `transaction()`), so the recorded context carries no unit handle, and a recorded row whose unit rolled back is only re-read by the deferred recompute. Same shape as the `after*` unit since #22782; nothing to change here.
- **Turso remote** still declares `supports.transactionsUnsupported`, so there a `before*` hook's writes stay stored after a refusal, and the `hookStoppedRefusal` sentence ("otherwise what was written before that point stays written") stays true; `summary-errors.ts` is unchanged.
- **Skills.** `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (Before vs After table) says a `before*` hook is "Within transaction" and "throw → rollback". That now holds on a transactional default driver, but the page is silent on the exits (another datasource, a driver with no transactions, code-registered hooks), on the cross-datasource refusal of a `before*` hook's `ctx.api` write, and on MongoDB needing a replica set. `skills/**` is outside this PR; follow-up #34504.
- Code-registered `before*` hooks that write through `ctx.api` stay outside any unit (the #22782 line) — a boundary, recorded, not filed.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-ctx-title-one-hop.integration.test.ts` is outside the claim's file surface too: its H2 pin was made red by this change on CI (Test Core 3/8 on 320f1f8646) and flipped here in fix round 1.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/scoped-transaction-late-write.dogfood.test.ts` is outside the claim's file surface: its fixture was made red by this change (see the dogfood block) and fixed here, as the battery rule requires.
- **Review follow-ups → #34563** (Blocked-by #34412): S1's live PostgreSQL measurement (the no-savepoint `25P02` consequence, now named in the changeset and `hooks.mdx` at `ea224164`), N3 (MongoDB standalone) and N5 (MongoDB replica set: the outcome of a `before*` hook that swallows its own failed `ctx.api` write).
- This PR owes an L1 review and a contract-tier L2 review (declared narrowing). At `ea224164`: L1 ACCEPT 6935125418, L2 PASS 6935186906 (S1 closed).

## Verification

Commands, exits and verdict lines are in the folded blocks below; head named in each.

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery (final head 320f1f8646)</summary>

- `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test"` (no shard, no path) after the closure build: `Test Files 476 passed | 3 skipped (479)`, `Tests 4022 passed | 44 skipped (4066)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The first battery, at abe9374566, had one red caused by this change: `test/scoped-transaction-late-write.dogfood.test.ts` › "ctx.api.transaction(fn) that rolls back: the hook never runs" (`Tests 1 failed | 4021 passed`). Its fixture used a `beforeInsert` hook precisely because the door opened no unit for one, so the hook's `ctx.api.transaction` owned its unit; now it joined the door's unit and the swallowed inner rollback kept its row. Fixture replaced (320f1f8646): the writer hook is a blocking `afterInsert` with `onError: 'log'` and no `condition`, which opens no door unit, so the transaction it opens is its own again. File re-run: `Tests 15 passed (15)`.

</details>
